title: Related-Key Security of the Identical-Key Construction
summary: The paper suggests possible resistance to some related-key attacks, but characterizing the attacks and identifying security-preserving relations remains open.

formal_statement.body: Characterize related-key attacks against $E_{k,k,k}$ and determine which relations preserve security.

scope.domain: Related-key cryptanalysis of an identical-key key-alternating block-cipher construction.
parameters: k: the key reused in all three positions of the construction
related-key relation: the class to be assessed for whether security is preserved
scope.unresolved_remainder: Characterize related-key attacks against the identical-key construction and determine which related-key relations preserve security.

citations.label: Key-Alternating Ciphers in a Provable Setting: Encryption Using a Small Number of Public Permutations - (Extended Abstract)

progress.summary: The source presents resistance to certain related-key attacks as a reasonable expectation for the identical-key variant, but gives no proof or complete classification.
citation_labels: Andrey Bogdanov et al., Key-Alternating Ciphers in a Provable Setting: Encryption Using a Small Number of Public Permutations - (Extended Abstract)
